title: Project File Library
description:
Turn your folder into a library where you can organize your files and texts Project File Library is an desktop file-library experience where folders and files become books. Choose a project folder from your computer, and the app transforms its contents into a small 3D scene that you can organize, revisit, and reshape.

 

 

Build Your Library• Choose a local folder and generate books from its files and folders.

• Move books between the floor, ordinary shelves, and a special hidden shelf.

• Add as many shelves as you need as your project grows.

• Save different arrangements for different folders.

• Restore your previous layouts from local library data.

 

Browse and Edit• Explore your folder through a file tree.

• Double-click text files to open and edit them.

• Split long text files into custom subgroups.

• Combine subgroups into larger groups for easier navigation.

• Save edited text, grouping data, layout data, and editor style settings locally.

 

A Local WorkspaceProject File Library works with files on your own computer. Arrangement data, text grouping information, and style settings are stored inside a local .lib folder in the selected project root. The app is designed around local organization rather than online accounts or cloud storage.
description_short: Turn your project folder into a calm 3D file library. Choose a local folder, watch files and folders become books, organize them onto shelves, edit text files, create groups and subgroups, and save your layout locally.
